FX-TILES-001.says: The settings as they start, scale 50, centre 50, 50, blend 0: tiles 8 by 5 set round the middle, one starting at column 4 and row 2.5, so the frame holds two tiles across and two down, cut at the edges, each pixel the mean of 2 by 2 points.

FX-TILES-002.says: Scale 100 with the centre at 50, 50: the one tile is the picture itself, untouched.

FX-TILES-003.says: Scale 100 with the centre at 25, 50: the picture slid four columns left, the four columns that fall off the left coming round on the right, pixel for pixel: column x is the drawing's column (x + 4) mod 16.

FX-TILES-004.says: Scale 25: tiles 4 by 2.5, one starting at column 6 and row 3.75, each pixel the mean of 4 by 4 points; across, the frame repeats every 4 columns.

FX-TILES-005.says: Scale 75: tiles 12 by 7.5, more than half the picture, so the tiles' edges show near the frame's sides, each pixel the mean of 2 by 2 points.

FX-TILES-006.says: Scale 33.3: 1 / 0.333 is just over 3, so 4 by 4 points a pixel; tiles 5.328 by 3.33.

FX-TILES-007.says: Scale 1, the least: tiles 0.16 by 0.1 of a pixel, each pixel the mean of 16 by 16 points, the most there are, so the picture becomes a fine even mixture.

FX-TILES-008.says: Scale 50 with the centre at 25, 50: the tiles start at column 0 instead of 4, so the frame is FX-TILES-001's slid four columns left, wrapping.

FX-TILES-009.says: Blend 50: halfway between FX-TILES-001's tiles and the drawing, every channel.

FX-TILES-011.says: Scale keyed from 100 at frame 0 to 50 at frame 4, linear: frame 0 the drawing, frame 2 scale 75 (FX-TILES-005), frame 4 FX-TILES-001.

FX-TILES-012.says: Blend keyed from 100 at frame 0 to 0 at frame 4: frame 0 the drawing, frame 2 FX-TILES-009, frame 4 FX-TILES-001.

FX-TILES-013.says: Centre keyed from 50, 50 at frame 0 to 25, 50 at frame 4 at scale 100: the picture slides left and wraps, two columns at frame 2.

FX-TILES-014.says: Scale eased from 50 at frame 0 to 1 at frame 4 on a curve that overshoots: at frame 2 it would pass below 1 and is held there, so frames 2 and 4 are FX-TILES-007.

FX-TILES-015.says: FX-TILES-001 with the layer moved three pixels right: the same tiles, moved; nothing grows, so the three columns past the right edge are cut and columns 0 to 2 stay empty.

FX-TILES-016.says: Scale 0.5, below 1. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-TILES-017.says: Scale 100.5, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-TILES-018.says: Blend -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-TILES-019.says: Blend 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-TILES-020.says: Centre at 1001, 50, past ten widths. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-TILES-021.says: Scale keyed to 0 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
